description: This Java class defines a Fragment named LogFragment that manages a LogView component for displaying log messages within an Android application. It handles view creation, layout configuration, and updating the UI when new log data is received.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays log messages using a custom LogView widget and manages user interface updates.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the view hierarchy including a ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, typefaces, padding, and other UI properties.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's view hierarchy, sets up a text change listener to auto-scroll when new log entries are added, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Provides access to the LogView instance used in the fragment.
